blurb: Play the whole game from one Disc 1 image on CSR. v0.2.9: fixes a New Game hang caused by a corrupted FIELD.BIN in the published v0.2.8 layer (layer was diffed against a stale/broken work bin). hint: CSR. Fields-only core; movies/endings not yet re-enabled.
betaNote: v0.2.9: fixes a New Game hang -- the v0.2.8 disc1.layer.json was diffed against a stale/corrupted work bin whose FIELD.BIN failed to decompress (invalid DEFLATE stream), so the layer shipped that corruption to every build using it. Regenerated the layer from a freshly-built, verified work bin (FIELD.BIN/WORLD.BIN both decompress correctly; reapplying the new layer onto the CSR base reproduces that work bin byte-for-byte). Retains all v0.2.8 fixes (BLACKBGB D1->D2 splice, Okumura LZSS LOST2 fix). Not yet tested on real hardware or replayed past New Game on DuckStation -- please playtest a full run. Manip movies and endings are currently disabled while this core is playtested standalone.
